style_context: Wilderness survival skills including shelter building, fire starting, first aid, water treatment, signaling for rescue, and outdoor emergency preparedness

images.description: Scout sitting inside a completed natural shelter made from branches and leaves, looking prepared and calm
Visual ranking of the five priorities of wilderness survival with icons showing the order and brief description of each
Grid showing 8 different wilderness injuries side-by-side (dehydration signs, hypothermia stages, blister formation, snake bite, spider bite, etc.) with clear identifying features labeled
All 10 Scout Essentials laid out on a backpack, each item clearly visible and organized in order
Completed trip plan form showing route on map, participant list, timeline, emergency contacts, and weather forecast
Pyramid diagram with the seven survival priorities stacked from bottom to top, each level showing priority number, name, and survival timeframe
Left side showing a panicked Scout making poor decisions with arrows pointing to negative outcomes, right side showing calm Scout making good decisions with positive outcomes
Well-organized first aid kit in waterproof pouch with compartments showing bandages, medications, tools, and items clearly visible
Five different shelter setups arranged side-by-side, each labeled with condition (cold and snowy, wet, hot and dry, windy, at water) showing appropriate shelter design for each
Three columns showing clothing layers for cold weather, hot weather, and wet weather conditions, each column displaying layered outfit from base to shell
Top-down view of properly organized campsite showing sleeping area, cooking area, food storage location with distances marked, and bear/raccoon protection measures
Three forest shelter types displayed side-by-side: lean-to shelter, debris shelter (A-frame), and natural shelter with rock overhang, each labeled with construction details
Scout actively building a debris shelter, showing the framework of branches leaning against a ridgepole and bundles of leaves/insulation nearby
Scout demonstrating proper ferro rod striking technique over a prepared tinder bundle, showing the correct striking angle and spark generation
Aerial view showing five large ground-to-air signals (X, V, arrow, F, checkmark) each properly arranged and labeled, visible from above as they would appear to aircraft
Top-down view showing sun position, mirror angle, and target alignment for proper signal mirror technique with angles and light path clearly marked
Three water treatment methods displayed side-by-side: boiling with pot and fire, purification tablets in water, and filter pump with labeled steps for each method
Grid showing five common edible plants with detailed illustrations of leaves, flowers, roots, and growth patterns, each plant clearly labeled with name and edible parts highlighted
Five signaling tools arranged together: cell phone, personal locator beacon, whistle, signal mirror, and flashlight, each clearly visible and labeled
Modern search and rescue coordination center with personnel working at desks with maps, radios, and technology coordinating rescue operations
